entity: Redlined 1930s (HOLC-graded) neighborhoods nationally: density of toxic-release plants by HOLC grade, A to D
what_we_add: TRI plants per 100 km2 by grade (D 13.35, C 5.82, B 2.21, A 0.07; D six times B) and D denser than B in 119 of 212 cities
why: Lane et al. 2022 finds, across HOLC-mapped areas, the number of industrial sources nearby rises from A to D: same finding, same direction (Estien quote missing, ignored). Its measure is industrial sources nearby, not TRI density, and no quote carries our per-grade numbers or the 119-of-212 count.
